# PDF fonts

Fonts embedded (subset) by `Exports::PdfCanvas` in the portfolio PDF export.
All are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt`.

| File | Used for | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NotoSans-Regular.ttf | Body text | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/main/fonts/NotoSans/hinted/ttf/NotoSans-Regular.ttf |
| NotoSans-Bold.ttf | Headings, labels | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/main/fonts/NotoSans/hinted/ttf/NotoSans-Bold.ttf |
| NotoSansJavanese-Regular.ttf | Fallback for Javanese script | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/main/fonts/NotoSansJavanese/hinted/ttf/NotoSansJavanese-Regular.ttf |
| NotoSansSymbols-Regular.ttf | Fallback for symbols such as arrows | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/main/fonts/NotoSansSymbols/hinted/ttf/NotoSansSymbols-Regular.ttf |

Characters that none of these fonts contain (for example emoji) are printed
as `[?]` so the reader can see that something was replaced.
